abstract.description: Produces an abstract, a summary or brief representation, of the text of the search results. The original text is replaced by the summary.

optional_args.name: maxterms
optional_args.description: The maximum number of terms to match. Accepted values are 1 to 1000.

optional_args.name: maxlines
optional_args.description: The maximum number of lines to match. Accepted values are 1 to 500.

accum.description: For each event where field is a number, the accum command calculates a running total or sum of the numbers. The accumulated sum can be returned to either the same field, or a newfield that you specify.

required_args.name: field
required_args.description: The name of the field that you want to calculate the accumulated sum for. The field must contain numeric values.

optional_args.name: newfield
optional_args.description: The name of a new field where you want the results placed.

addcoltotals.description: The addcoltotals command appends a new result to the end of the search result set. The result contains the sum of each numeric field or you can specify which fields to summarize.

optional_args.name: wc-field-list
optional_args.description: A space delimited list of valid field names. The addcoltotals command calculates the sum only for the fields in the list you specify.

optional_args.name: labelfield
optional_args.description: Specify a field name to add to the result set.

optional_args.name: label
optional_args.description: Used with the labelfield argument to add a label in the summary event.

addinfo.description: Adds fields to each event that contain global, common information about the search. This command is primarily an internally-used component of Summary Indexing.

addtotals.description: The addtotals command computes the arithmetic sum of all numeric fields for each search result. The results appear in the Statistics tab.

optional_args.name: field-list
optional_args.description: One or more numeric fields, delimited with a space. Only the fields specified in the <field-list> are summed.

optional_args.name: row
optional_args.description: Specifies whether to calculate the sum of the <field-list> for each event.

optional_args.name: col
optional_args.description: Specifies whether to add a new event, referred to as a summary event, at the bottom of the list of events.

optional_args.name: fieldname
optional_args.description: Used to specify the name of the field that contains the calculated sum of the field-list for each event.

optional_args.name: labelfield
optional_args.description: Used to specify a field for the summary event label.

optional_args.name: label
optional_args.description: Used to specify a row label for the summary event.

analyzefields.description: Using <field> as a discrete random variable, this command analyzes all numerical fields to determine the ability for each of those fields to predict the value of the classfield.

required_args.name: classfield
required_args.description: For best results, classfield should have two distinct values, although multiclass analysis is possible.

anomalies.description: Use the anomalies command to look for events or field values that are unusual or unexpected. The anomalies command assigns an unexpectedness score to each event and places that score in a new field named unexpectedness.

optional_args.name: threshold
optional_args.description: A number to represent the upper limit of expected or normal events.

optional_args.name: labelonly
optional_args.description: Specifies if you want the output result set to include all events or only the events that are above the threshold value.

optional_args.name: normalize
optional_args.description: Specifies whether or not to normalize numeric text in the fields.

optional_args.name: maxvalues
optional_args.description: Specifies the size of the sliding set of previous events to include when determining the unexpectedness of a field value.

optional_args.name: field
optional_args.description: The field to analyze when determining the unexpectedness of an event.

optional_args.name: denylist
optional_args.description: The name of a CSV file that contains a list of events that are expected and should be ignored.

optional_args.name: denylistthreshold
optional_args.description: Specifies a similarity score threshold for matching incoming events to denylisted events.

anomalousvalue.description: The anomalousvalue command computes an anomaly score for each field of each event, relative to the values of this field across other events. For numerical fields, it identifies or summarizes the values in the data that are anomalous either by frequency of occurrence or number of standard deviations from the mean.

optional_args.name: maxanofreq
optional_args.description: Maximum anomalous frequency is expressed as a floating point number between 0 and 1.

optional_args.name: minnormfreq
optional_args.description: Minimum normal frequency is expressed as a floating point number between 0 and 1.

optional_args.name: minsupcount
optional_args.description: Minimum supported count must be a positive integer.

optional_args.name: minsupfreq
optional_args.description: Minimum supported frequency is expressed as a floating point number between 0 and 1.

optional_args.name: action
optional_args.description: Specify whether to return the anomaly score (annotate), filter out events that are not anomalous values (filter), or return a summary of anomaly statistics (summary).

optional_args.name: pthresh
optional_args.description: Probability threshold (as a decimal) that has to be met for a value to be considered anomalous.

anomalydetection.description: A transforming command that identifies anomalous events by computing a probability for each event and then detecting unusually small probabilities. The probability is defined as the product of the frequencies of each individual field value in the event.

optional_args.name: method
optional_args.description: Select the method of anomaly detection.

optional_args.name: action
optional_args.syntax: action = filter | annotate | summary | remove | transform
optional_args.description: The actions and defaults depend on the method that you specify.

optional_args.name: pthresh
optional_args.description: Used with method=histogram or method=zscore. Sets the probability threshold, as a decimal number, that has to be met for an event to be deemed anomalous.

optional_args.name: cutoff
optional_args.description: Sets the upper bound threshold on the number of anomalies. This option applies to only the histogram method.

append.description: Appends the results of a subsearch to the current results. The append command runs only over historical data and does not produce correct results if used in a real-time search.

required_args.name: subsearch
required_args.description: A secondary search where you specify the source of the events that you want to append. The subsearch must be enclosed in square brackets.

optional_args.name: extendtimerange
optional_args.description: Specifies whether to include the subsearch time range in the time range for the entire search.

optional_args.name: maxtime
optional_args.description: The maximum time, in seconds, to spend on the subsearch before automatically finalizing.

optional_args.name: maxout
optional_args.description: The maximum number of result rows to output from the subsearch.

appendcols.description: Appends the fields of the subsearch results with the input search results. All fields of the subsearch are combined into the current results, with the exception of internal fields.

required_args.name: subsearch
required_args.description: A secondary search added to the main search.

optional_args.name: override
optional_args.description: If the override argument is false, and if a field is present in both a subsearch result and the main result, the main result is used.

optional_args.name: maxtime
optional_args.description: The maximum time, in units of seconds, to spend on the subsearch before automatically finalizing.

optional_args.name: maxout
optional_args.description: The maximum number of result rows to output from the subsearch.

optional_args.name: timeout
optional_args.description: The maximum time, in units of seconds, to wait for subsearch to fully finish.

appendpipe.description: Appends the result of the subpipeline to the search results. Unlike a subsearch, the subpipeline is not run first. The subpipeline is run when the search reaches the appendpipe command.

optional_args.name: run_in_preview
optional_args.description: Specifies whether or not display the impact of the appendpipe command in the preview.

optional_args.name: subpipeline
optional_args.description: A list of commands that are applied to the search results from the commands that occur in the search before the appendpipe command.

arules.description: The arules command looks for associative relationships between field values. The command returns a table with the following columns: Given fields, Implied fields, Strength, Given fields support, and Implied fields support.

required_args.name: field-list
required_args.description: The list of field names. At least two fields must be specified.

optional_args.name: sup
optional_args.description: Specify a support limit. Associations with computed support levels smaller than this value are not included in the output results.

optional_args.name: conf
optional_args.description: Specify a confidence limit. Associations with a confidence (expressed as Strength field) are not included in the output results.

associate.description: The associate command identifies correlations between fields. The command tries to find a relationship between pairs of fields by calculating a change in entropy based on their values.

optional_args.name: supcnt
optional_args.description: Specifies the minimum number of times that the reference key=reference value combination must appear.

optional_args.name: supfreq
optional_args.description: Specifies the minimum frequency of reference key=reference value combination as a fraction of the number of total events.

optional_args.name: improv
optional_args.description: Specifies a limit, or minimum entropy improvement, for the target key.

autoregress.description: Prepares your events for calculating the autoregression, or the moving average, by copying one or more of the previous values for field into each event.

required_args.name: field
required_args.description: The name of a field. Most usefully a field with numeric values.

optional_args.name: p
optional_args.description: Specifies which prior events to copy values from. You can specify a single integer or a numeric range.

optional_args.name: newfield
optional_args.description: If p is set to a single integer, the newfield argument specifies a field name to copy the single field value into.

awssnsalert.description: The awssnsalert command is used with the Splunk Add-on for AWS.

bin.description: Puts continuous numerical values into discrete sets, or bins, by adjusting the value of <field> so that all of the items in a particular set have the same value.

optional_args.name: bins
optional_args.description: Sets the maximum number of bins to discretize into.

optional_args.name: minspan
optional_args.description: Specifies the smallest span granularity to use automatically inferring span from the data time range.

optional_args.name: span
optional_args.description: Sets the size of each bin, using a span length based on a logarithm-based span or based on time.

optional_args.name: start
optional_args.description: Sets the minimum extents for numerical bins.

optional_args.name: end
optional_args.description: Sets the maximum extents for numerical bins.

optional_args.name: aligntime
optional_args.description: Align the bin times to something other than base UTC time (epoch 0).

bucket.description: The bucket command is an alias for the bin command.

bucketdir.description: Replaces a field value with higher-level grouping, such as replacing filenames with directories. Returns the maxcount events, by taking the incoming events and rolling up multiple sources into directories.

required_args.name: pathfield
required_args.description: Specify a field name that has a path value.

required_args.name: sizefield
required_args.description: Specify a numeric field that defines the size of bucket.

optional_args.name: countfield
optional_args.description: Specify a numeric field that describes the count of events.

optional_args.name: maxcount
optional_args.description: Specify the total number of events to bucket.

optional_args.name: sep
optional_args.description: The separating character. Specify either a forward slash / or double back slashes \\.

chart.description: The chart command is a transforming command that returns your results in a table format. The results can then be used to display the data as a chart, such as a column, line, area, or pie chart.

required_args.name: stats-agg-term OR sparkline-agg-term OR eval-expression
required_args.description: A statistical aggregation function, sparkline aggregation function, or eval expression.

optional_args.name: agg
optional_args.description: Specify an aggregator or function.

optional_args.name: cont
optional_args.description: Specifies if the bins are continuous.

optional_args.name: format
optional_args.description: Used to construct output field names when multiple data series are used in conjunction with a split-by-field.

optional_args.name: limit
optional_args.description: Only valid when a column-split is specified. Use the limit option to specify the number of results that should appear in the output.

optional_args.name: sep
optional_args.description: Used to construct output field names when multiple data series are used in conjunctions with a split-by field.

optional_args.name: dedup_splitvals
optional_args.description: Specifies whether to remove duplicate values in multivalued BY clause fields.

cluster.description: The cluster command groups events together based on how similar they are to each other. Unless you specify a different field, cluster groups events based on the contents of the _raw field.

optional_args.name: t
optional_args.description: Sets the cluster threshold, which controls the sensitivity of the clustering.

optional_args.name: delims
optional_args.description: Configures the set of delimiters used to tokenize the raw string.

optional_args.name: showcount
optional_args.description: If showcount=false, indexers cluster its own events before clustering on the search head.

optional_args.name: countfield
optional_args.description: Name of the field to which the cluster size is to be written if showcount=true is true.

optional_args.name: labelfield
optional_args.description: Name of the field to write the cluster number to.

optional_args.name: field
optional_args.description: Name of the field to analyze in each event.

optional_args.name: labelonly
optional_args.description: Select whether to preserve incoming events and annotate them with the cluster they belong to (labelonly=true) or output only the cluster fields as new events (labelonly=false).

optional_args.name: match
optional_args.description: Select the method used to determine the similarity between events.

cofilter.description: Use this command to determine how many times a value in <field1> and a value in <field2> occur together. This command implements one step in a collaborative filtering analysis for making recommendations.

collect.description: Adds the results of a search to a summary index that you specify. You must create the summary index before you invoke the collect command.

required_args.name: index
required_args.description: Name of the summary index where the events are added. The index must exist before the events are added.

optional_args.name: addinfo
optional_args.description: Use this option to specify whether to prefix search time and time-range information fields on to each summary index event.

optional_args.name: addtime
optional_args.description: Use this option to specify whether to prefix a time field on to each event.

optional_args.name: file
optional_args.description: The file name where you want the events to be written.

optional_args.name: host
optional_args.description: The name of the host that you want to specify for the events.

optional_args.name: marker
optional_args.description: A string, usually of key-value pairs, to append to each event written out.

optional_args.name: output_format
optional_args.description: Specifies the output format for the summary indexing.

optional_args.name: run_in_preview
optional_args.description: Controls whether the collect command is enabled during preview generation.

optional_args.name: spool
optional_args.description: If set to true, the summary indexing file is written to the Splunk spool directory.

optional_args.name: source
optional_args.description: The name of the source that you want to specify for the events.

optional_args.name: sourcetype
optional_args.description: The name of the source type that you want to specify for the events.

optional_args.name: testmode
optional_args.description: Toggle between testing and real mode.

optional_args.name: timeformat
optional_args.description: Controls the format of the timestamp that is written to the stash file before it is indexed.

optional_args.name: uselb
optional_args.description: Controls how line breaks are used to split events.

convert.description: The convert command converts field values in your search results into numerical values. Unless you use the AS clause, the original values are replaced by the new values.

required_args.name: convert-function
required_args.syntax: auto() | ctime() | dur2sec() | memk() | mktime() | mstime() | none() | num() | rmcomma() | rmunit()
required_args.description: Functions to use for the conversion.

optional_args.name: timeformat
optional_args.description: Specify the output format for the converted time field. The timeformat option is used by ctime and mktime functions.

optional_args.name: field
optional_args.description: Creates a new field with the name you specify to place the converted values into.
